thread:
nora: Quick signal from the int4 bring-up of rwd-v3.6-small: divergence in the long-seq cohort where relevance ordering flips for multi-passage prompts. Canary at 4%. Need to decide gating tweak.
diego: link: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v3.6-small/int4  looks like top-3 ordering swaps, not total score collapse.
sasha: any per-token importance shift? i.e., is attention moving to earlier tokens vs later ones?
trent: ran a token-attribution diff on a sample thread: attention mass shifts ~6% earlier on avg for affected outputs. that correlates with recombined passage scoring bugs.
nora: ok, hypothesis: quant noise increases score variance leading to unstable tie-breaks. We should consider a "variance-aware gate" rather than pure mean-delta. proposal: require both mean MRR delta < 3% AND coefficient-of-variation (std/mean) delta < 0.04 on slice.
diego: nice, that could prevent noisy promote where mean looks OK but volatility high. also add per-request clamp: if candidate_score_std > 0.07 then shadow-route that request to fp32 and log.
sasha: agree. Also suggest an expedited shadow sampling for the long-seq cohort (increase to 100% shadow for 2 hours) to get better variance estimates.
route-bot: queued change: adjust-canary rwd-v3.6-small int4 -> canary:2%, shadow_longseq:100% for 2h, variance_gate:enabled.
trent: config snippet (rollout policy format):
```
rule: variance_aware_promote
match: slice == "long_seq"
metrics:
  mean_mrr_delta: "<=0.03"
  cov_delta: "<=0.04"   # coefficient of variation change
per_request_fallback:
  trigger: candidate_score_std >= 0.07
  action: route_to: rwd-v3.5-fp32
  log_shadow: true
```

nora: add telemetry guard: if shadowed_requests_pct > 30% OR routed_longseq_errors > 0.4% for 10m -> auto-pause and page #eng-oncall. Also add hysteresis: once fallback triggers for a request, keep that session pinned to fp32 for 20m.
diego: who owns short replay to validate this? i can run 6h replay on two production slices and produce variance delta plots.
sasha: i'll open PR for the rollout policy and add unit tests for the metric calculator (cov calculation). also adding an eval job to compute cov across daily windows for the long-seq slice.
route-bot: change applied. canary reduced to 2%, variance_aware_promote active, shadowing active. monitor created: VAR_GATE_1779994321.
trent: quick replay on 24h sample with variance gate shows mean MRR dip stays within 2.1% and cov_delta reduced to 0.02 with gate; ordering flips reduced by ~70%. attaching traces to ticket.
nora: good. keep hold for 24h and collect additional shadow stats. owner: diego 12h watch, sasha PR + eval job, trent replay traces.
sasha: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/789. tests included. :thumbsup:
diego: will post interim charts in 3h. if anything weird pops, we rollback to v3.5 globally.
route-bot: guard created: AUTO_PAUSE_ON_VARIANCE_1779994321. will trigger per config.
nora: thanks team. Objective is to get robust promote decisions that account for volatility, not just average delta. follow-up update in 6h.
diego: noted.
trent: one more thought: add a small epsilon smoothing to candidate scores for quant variants during ranking to reduce tie sensitivity until model stabilizes. I'll prototype a smoothing weight in the reranker and report perf impact.
sasha: make it optional behind a flag so we can A/B test smoothing effect.
nora: +1. add flag flag:quant_score_smooth=0.02 to the canary config behind the variance gate.
route-bot: flag added to canary config. live.
nora: thanks everyone. keeping the canary conservative while we bake variance signals. if green after 24h, consider 6h step-up ramp with variance thermostat engaged.
trent: thanks. will watch for ordering flip metric and send a note if >5% flips in any 30m window.
